POST /v1/projects.description: Two steps: the device first creates a conversation of kind `project` (POST /v1/conversations) that holds the team and the sealed tasks, then calls this with its id. When the organization's flow f2 needs approval the project waits as `Pending approval` and goes live (`On track`) when the last approver agrees.
POST /v1/projects.access: a role with Projects: Create project

project.id: uuid. Same as the project's conversation id
project.status: string. Pending approval | On track | At risk | Off track | Delayed | Done | Cancelled

response.approval: object. The approval request when one is needed

errors.400: Dates not like 2026-12-15, budget not a percentage, or the project conversation was not created first

projects.id: uuid. Same as the project's conversation id
projects.status: string. Pending approval | On track | At risk | Off track | Delayed | Done | Cancelled

PATCH /v1/projects/{id}.description: Status, due date, budget used, sync and owner. Tasks, milestones, sprints and risks are sealed records: use POST /v1/containers/{id}/records.
PATCH /v1/projects/{id}.access: a role with Projects: Manage team to change the owner; Projects: View otherwise

request.status: string. On track | At risk | Off track | Delayed | Done | Cancelled
request.owner: uuid. The new owner; must be on the project team

response.id: uuid. Same as the project's conversation id
response.status: string. Pending approval | On track | At risk | Off track | Delayed | Done | Cancelled

errors.400: Not a status from the list, bad date, or the new owner is not on the team
errors.409: pending: the project is waiting for approval

GET /v1/settings.description: Everything the Settings page shows: profile, security policy, subscription, billing contact, the plans and add-ons on offer, and seats in use.
GET /v1/settings.access: a role with Settings: View settings

profile.name: string, required. Up to 120 characters
profile.logo: string. PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG data URL up to 1 MB
profile.currency: string. Three letter code like KES

security.session: string. Minutes of inactivity before sign-out, from the list the app offers
security.retention: string. Months to keep records, from the list
security.maxFileMB: string. Largest file attached to a communication, MB
security.maxVideoMB: string. Largest video posted in forums, chats and the wall, MB
security.userQuotaMB: string. Default storage per person, MB

subscription.seats: integer. 1 up to what the plan covers

billing.cardLast4: string. Only the last four digits are kept

plans.name: string
plans.price: integer. Per seat per month in major units

response.delete_after: timestamp. When a requested deletion will happen

PUT /v1/settings/profile.access: a role with Settings: Edit organization profile

request.name: string, required. Up to 120 characters
request.logo: string. PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG data URL up to 1 MB
request.currency: string. Three letter code like KES

errors.400: Missing name, bad email, time zone or currency, or an invalid or oversized logo

PUT /v1/settings/security.description: Values for `session`, `retention`, sizes and quotas must come from the lists the app offers.
PUT /v1/settings/security.access: a role with Settings: Edit organization profile

request.session: string. Minutes of inactivity before sign-out, from the list the app offers
request.retention: string. Months to keep records, from the list
request.maxFileMB: string. Largest file attached to a communication, MB
request.maxVideoMB: string. Largest video posted in forums, chats and the wall, MB
request.userQuotaMB: string. Default storage per person, MB

errors.400: A value is not one of the allowed choices

PUT /v1/settings/subscription.summary: Change the plan, seats or add-ons
PUT /v1/settings/subscription.access: a role with Settings: Manage subscription

request.seats: integer. 1 up to what the plan covers

subscription.seats: integer. 1 up to what the plan covers

errors.400: Unknown plan or add-on, seats outside what the plan covers, or a bad cancel date
errors.409: seats_in_use: more people are in the organization than the seats asked for

PUT /v1/settings/billing.summary: Change the billing contact and card details
PUT /v1/settings/billing.description: Only the card brand, last four digits and expiry are stored.
PUT /v1/settings/billing.access: a role with Settings: Manage subscription

request.cardLast4: string. Only the last four digits are kept

errors.400: Card digits, expiry or email not valid

GET /v1/billing/invoices.access: a role with Settings: Manage subscription

GET /v1/billing/invoices/{no}/etr.description: Lines, totals, VAT and fiscal fields. `fiscal.integrated` is true only when a fiscal device or KRA eTIMS issued the numbers.
GET /v1/billing/invoices/{no}/etr.access: a role with Settings: Manage subscription

buyer.name: string, required. Up to 120 characters
buyer.logo: string. PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG data URL up to 1 MB
buyer.currency: string. Three letter code like KES

GET /v1/settings/widgets.summary: Home widget settings for the organization
GET /v1/settings/widgets.access: any signed-in member of the organization (token issued with `org`)

PUT /v1/settings/widgets.access: a role with Home: Manage widget settings

request.<key>: any. A JSON object up to 32 KB

POST /v1/settings/deletion.summary: Ask for the organization to be deleted
POST /v1/settings/deletion.description: Everything is erased 30 days later unless cancelled with DELETE /v1/settings/deletion.
POST /v1/settings/deletion.access: a role with Settings: Manage subscription

request.confirm: string, required. The organization's name, exactly

response.delete_after: timestamp. When the erasure will happen

DELETE /v1/settings/deletion.access: a role with Settings: Manage subscription

GET /v1/security/activity.description: Today's active people and who has not been seen for one week or two.
GET /v1/security/activity.access: a role with Security: View alerts

response.today: integer. People who used the system today
response.active: integer. Active people in the organization

GET /v1/security/alerts.access: a role with Security: View alerts

query.open: 1 for alerts that are not closed

alerts.rule: string. Rule id, r1 to r8
alerts.title: string
alerts.status: string. Open | Investigating | Resolved | False alarm

POST /v1/security/alerts/{id}/status.access: a role with Security: Resolve alerts

request.status: string, required. Investigating | Resolved | False alarm
request.comment: string, required. What you found or did, 3 to 1000 characters

errors.400: Not an allowed status, or the comment is too short or long
errors.409: closed: the alert is already closed

GET /v1/security/rules.description: r1 repeated failed sign-ins, r2 sign-in from a new country, r3 mass file download, r4 after-hours admin action, r5 role or rights change, r6 secure link opened from an unusual IP, r7 outside sharing spike, r8 tampered records. Each can be switched off or have its severity changed.
GET /v1/security/rules.access: a role with Security: View alerts

PUT /v1/security/rules/{id}.summary: Switch a rule on or off or change its severity
PUT /v1/security/rules/{id}.access: a role with Security: Manage rules

GET /v1/security/blocks.description: Times sign-in was stopped after repeated wrong passwords: people of this organization, and addresses blocked for trying accounts that are not members (their email is masked). Blocks lift by themselves.
GET /v1/security/blocks.access: a role with Security: View logs

GET /v1/security/logs.description: Newest first. The log is hash-chained: entries cannot be changed or removed unnoticed.
GET /v1/security/logs.access: a role with Security: View logs

logs.rule: string. The rule that flagged it, when one did

GET /v1/security/logs/export.description: Same filters as the log. The export is itself logged. Cells that start with = + - or @ are escaped so spreadsheets do not run them.
GET /v1/security/logs/export.access: a role with Security: Export logs

query.format: csv for CSV; anything else gives an Excel file (.xlsx)

GET /v1/security/integrity.description: Walks the organization's ledger and reports whether it is intact.
GET /v1/security/integrity.access: a role with Security: View logs

response.intact: boolean. false if anything was altered
response.broken_at: integer. Sequence number where the chain breaks (only when not intact)
response.reason: string. Why it breaks (only when not intact)

POST /v1/calls.summary: Start a voice or video call
POST /v1/calls.description: `mode` in the answer is `sfu` (a room on a media server: connect a LiveKit client to `sfu.url` with `sfu.token`) or `mesh` (a small peer-to-peer room, up to 8 people: open a WebSocket to `url` with `token`). Private calls are always `mesh`; forum calls and meetings are `sfu` when the deployment has a media server. In a big room people beyond the open-mic size join as listeners until the host brings them on stage. Media is encrypted on the devices with a key made from the conversation's key.
POST /v1/calls.access: a role with the matching right (Private calls, Forums: Start calls, Calendar: Start meeting)

request.context: string. dm | forum | meeting | standup | project (meeting when absent)
request.conversation: uuid. The conversation the call belongs to; its members are notified

call.status: string. ringing | active | ended | missed | declined

sfu.url: string. wss:// address of the media server
sfu.token: string. Join pass for that server
sfu.limit: integer. Most people in the room
sfu.stage: integer. Most people speaking at once
sfu.open_mic: integer. Rooms up to this size: everyone speaks

response.token: string. mesh only: one-time pass for the signalling socket
response.url: string. mesh only: ws:// address of the signalling service

errors.409: room_full: the room holds its limit
errors.429: too_many_calls: the organization is already running its limit of calls
errors.503: calls_busy or calls_unavailable: try again in a moment

POST /v1/calls/{id}/join.access: someone invited, or a member of the call's conversation

errors.423: room_locked: the host locked the call

errors.409: cannot_decline: only a ringing private call can be declined

POST /v1/calls/{id}/control.summary: Host and moderator controls for a big call
POST /v1/calls/{id}/control.description: Carried out by the media server.
POST /v1/calls/{id}/control.access: the host or a moderator (Forums: Moderate); only the host can end the call or act on the host

request.action: string, required. mute | cam_off | remove | mute_all | lock | unlock | end | stage_on | stage_off
request.identity: string. The participant's id in the room, for actions on one person

errors.403: Not a host or moderator, or the action needs the host
errors.409: stage_full: the stage already has its limit of speakers

GET /v1/calls/history.access: any signed-in member of the organization (token issued with `org`)

POST /v1/calls/sfu-hook.description: Called by the media servers with a signed token; not for integrations. Keeps call history and room counts current.
POST /v1/calls/sfu-hook.access: a media server holding the shared API key

errors.401: bad_signature: not signed by a known media server

GET /readyz.summary: Are the database and message bus reachable

GET /v1/dev/outbox.description: Only exists outside production: shows the emails the dev mailer would have sent (reset codes, invitations).
